# How to read this

* Each block below is one prompt, copied verbatim (typos kept).
* "Mid-turn" = sent while the agent was still working on the previous prompt.
* The agent's one clarifying question is shown where it occurred.
* Output: `TIMSS_PISA_trends.html` (3 figures, 2 tables).

# Prompts

1. First request

    ```
    can you find out PISA's scores for partcipating countries
    end output: time series plot of all countries
    facet(grades ~ subjects)
    i will give you auto mode on the condition that you do not touch any existing files
    ```

    * Agent's question: PISA tests only 15-year-olds, so it has no grade dimension.
      What should the facet rows be?
    * Answer chosen: TIMSS grades 4 & 8 (TIMSS tests grade 4 and grade 8 students).

1. Checking what the agent creates

    ```
    what are the files do you work on?
    ```

1. Go-ahead

    ```
    good
    ```

1. Mid-turn: add PISA

    ```
    please also work on PISA
    rows by sex
    ```

1. Report

    ```
    can you make a quarto file of the above and render?
    ```

1. Mid-turn: latest PISA round

    ```
    can you also download pisa 2022
    ```

1. Highlight countries

    ```
    PISA
    use diff colours for Japan (red bold), Korea, US, Finland, mean line (light green)
    use lightbox
    note obs years in figure footnote
    ```

1. Mid-turn: same style for TIMSS

    ```
    same colour scheme for TIMSS
    ```

1. Control for changing country composition

    ```
    another figure for PISA
    fix the countries as countries observed in 2000
    so compositional changes will be controlled
    ```

1. Keep two countries with one missing cycle

    ```
    add US and spain to reading
    ```

1. Which countries to draw

    ```
    for 3rd fig, include all countries observed in 2000
    for 2nd fig, include all countries
    ```

1. Document structure

    ```
    you need 2 subsections for PISA
    ```

1. Zoom without changing the mean

    ```
    for 3rd fig, set ymin = 450 but still use below y min countries to compute mean
    ```

# Points for discussion

* Prompt 1 asked for `facet(grades ~ subjects)`, but PISA has no grades.
  Only the agent's clarifying question led to the TIMSS (grade x subject) /
  PISA (sex x subject) split.
* Prompt 9 asks for a fixed set of countries. A "country observed in 2000"
  may still miss a later round, so the agent kept only countries with a score
  in every round for the mean, and reported which ones were left out.
* Prompt 13 separates what is shown (y-axis from 450) from what is computed
  (mean over all countries in the fixed set).
